about: research/sp_ruler/evidence.js: the chance a Suggested Parlays set's team legs are ranked at today (legModel: the player model, raw) against DraftKings' no-vig chance (legFair), and two checks of that ruler. Read only: nothing fitted, tuned or chosen. Intervals are 90% bootstraps over games, 10,000 resamples, seeded.

page.ml: g.model.pHome, the player model's win chance, raw (legModel); never pulled to the market
page.spread: Phi((m + h) / 14.5), m the side's expected margin from the player model's spread, h its line (legModel)
page.total: the market's own: its two prices with the margin out in proportion (legModel), the same number as legFair
page.pool: spPool keeps a team side with that chance in [0.45, 0.97) and less than 0.15 over legFair; 0.03 over the implied price marks it Value

walkForward.note: research/backtest_games.csv: each season on the player model's parameters fitted on the seasons before it alone; "known" the players who did play (a perfect injury report, the model's best case), "naive" the previous game's lineup. Market: the closing line (data/odds_hist.csv: DraftKings in 2023-24 and 2025-26 mostly, ESPN BET in 2024-25), the moneylines' two prices in proportion. No closing spread or total price is kept, so a spread's and a total's market chance is 50% (-110 a side). SIGMA 14.5 was measured on the 2025-26 fold (research/sigma.json), so that season's spread is not wholly out of sample. A total's model row is an aside: the page ranks a total at the market's chance.

draftkings.note: research/sp_ruler/dk_game_lines_2027.csv: the job's last read of DraftKings' game lines before each tip (lines.json's history, from 26 October 2026), every price DraftKings' own, so a spread's and a total's market chance is its two prices in proportion. Model: data/predictions.csv, the player model's pre-tip call frozen at tip. teamEloMl: the Team Elo column of the same file, an aside (the page never ranks a leg on it).

atTip.note: data/games.csv: the line ESPN's scoreboard carried, frozen at tip (from 20 October 2026); no spread or total price, so those are at 50%.

shadow.note: data/props_shadow_lines.csv, the props ledger's graded lines (its p_market is the fair Over by the page's rule), joined to data/props_2027.csv for the line: a cross-check of the box-score grading above

verdict.rule: true only where the model's log loss less the market's has its 90% interval wholly below 0 out of sample (both walk-forward lineups)
